app.name: Bold tiles
app.summary: An entity's value, state or switch in large bold letters, the name small above it, to read from across the room.
app.label: Label
app.label_hint: The words shown on the tile. Changing it updates the screen at once; leave it empty to use the tile's name.
app.size_hint: How much of the tile the large text may take. It never grows past what fits.
app.decimals_hint: Automatic shows the number as Home Assistant has it, with at most one decimal.
app.unit_hint: The unit (°F, %, kWh) beside the number, smaller.
app.alert_hint: Red while a door or window stands open, a lock is unlocked or a cover is open.
app.tap_hint: What a tap on the tile does. Popup opens a large popup with the state and one big key to lock or unlock it (or open or close a cover, or turn a switch or light on or off).
app.color_hint: A soft colour behind the name while the light or switch is on.
app.tap_value_hint: Graph and forecast opens a large card with the last week of this sensor as a graph and the forecast of the weather entity below.
app.forecast_hint: The weather entity whose daily forecast the card shows (for example the forecast of this sensor's place).
